Doctor of Pharmacy

As a future pharmacist, you’ll be at the forefront of healthcare, serving as the go-to expert on medications and their effects—all while advocating for patients’ well-being. Our accelerated Doctor of Pharmacy is designed to prepare you to be ready for practice in just three years, developing you into a dynamic leader and innovator in the field. With smaller class sizes, we’ll give you personalized attention and support as you learn to make a meaningful impact in your community and beyond.

Curriculum

Overview

The Doctor of Pharmacy is a three-year accelerated program. Students attend school year-round in the first and second years to complete the didactic portion of the curriculum. In the third year, students gain hands-on experience by working in various practice settings, allowing them to refine their clinical and communication skills.


The Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) requires prerequisite coursework equaling 62 semester credits (93 quarter credits) that equate to a two- to three-year undergraduate coursework before admission.

Doctor of Pharmacy students have the opportunity to concurrently complete a Master of Business Administration or Master of Science in Human Resource Leadership while completing the Doctor of Pharmacy. For more information, meet with your admissions advisor and view admissions requirements.


Tuition for the Doctor of Pharmacy program is all-inclusive, with locked-in contract pricing at the time of matriculation. See more tuition information.
